liz (product): Heads-up — Quicksilver just opened a P1. They're seeing intermittent 500s on Dedicated in us-west-2 (customer impact: checkout failures). Need engineering commitment window and short-term workaround.

karthik (eng-platform): Thanks Liz. Are these errors coming from runtime NGINX or upstream model service? Any recent deploys?

liz (product): Quicksilver says errors spike during bursts. No deploys from them. We rolled a small routing config change earlier today but rollout was targeted.

jen (sre): Pulling logs now. If it's 5xx mid-request could be model OOMs or proxy 502/504s. I'll run an initial grep.

oncall-bot: incident created: INC-2026-0423 Quicksilver P1 - Dedicated 5xx spikes (linked runbook: https://redwood.internal/ops/incidents/INC-2026-0423)

jen (sre): quick log snippet:
```
2026-04-23T14:02:11Z caller=proxy.go status=502 upstream=dedicated-pool-7 instance=pool7-az1-3
2026-04-23T14:02:12Z caller=runtime.go err="kv cache allocation failed: OOM" model=redwood-7b seq=512
```

anna (ops): Customer is asking for ETA and if we can throttle bursts or fallback to hosted models. They want a workaround within 2 hours.

karthik (eng-platform): Short-term: enable routing policy to divert 30% traffic to hosted fallback for Quicksilver and drop seq len to 256 for dedicated pools serving them. I can push the routing change if we agree.

liz (product): That sounds reasonable. Confirming with customer that partial fallback is acceptable.

jen (sre): If Karthik can flip the route, I'll monitor p99 and OOMs. Also suggest adding a temporary batch size cap: set env var INFER_MAX_BATCH=8 on pool7 nodes.

karthik (eng-platform): Will open a PR for config flip and post the change here. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/routing/pulls/487 — plan: canary 10% -> 30% -> 100% (if stable). ETA: 30m for first canary.

anna (ops): Noted. I'll message Quicksilver to accept fallback. If they decline, we need alternative: increase dedicated pool size (hotfix) or apply per-tenant rate limit.

liz (product): Customer agreed to partial fallback for now. Please proceed.

jen (sre): Starting monitoring runbook checks and alert thresholds. If OOM persists after rate reduction, escalate to runtime team for kernel/quantization rollback.

karthik (eng-platform): Pushed canary at 14:38 UTC. Observability: traffic diverted 10% to hosted, errors reduced by ~35% in the first 5m. Will ramp per plan and post updates. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: update INC-2026-0423 status=investigating owner=@karthik

liz (product): Thanks team. Please add any postmortem action items here when stable (hotfix, autoscale policy changes, customer routing docs).

jen (sre): Quick checklist items for postmortem: 1) confirm root cause (OOM vs proxy) 2) add tenant-level rate-limit guardrails 3) add pre-rollout load test for routing config changes

karthik (eng-platform): Will follow up with a short runbook PR and a timeline for Dedicated capacity autoscale improvements.

liz (product): Closing loop — will keep customer updated. Ping here when we hit stable or need exec escalation. :eyes:
